what: On the workout summary, give "Summary unavailable" a Try again button
why: When the summary cannot be read after Finish, the member gets only Done; every other page in this area (a saved workout, a routine, records, photos, the report) already offers Try again, so this is the one dead end at the proudest moment of the day
impact_why: Rare, but it hits right after a finished workout, when the member most wants to see the result
my_view: My view: do it; the same Try again the other pages use, re-reading the summary. The workout is already saved, so this is only about not losing the payoff screen.

what: For a gym member, add the gym's Bring a friend link to a shared workout picture and text (one line: "Train with me at <gym>")
why: Sharing a workout is the moment a member is proudest, and the picture already carries the gym's brand; today a friend who sees it has no way to act, while the Bring a friend link (the enquiry lands with the gym) lives only on the Gym tab
impact_why: Turns every shared workout into a possible new paying gym member, which is what gym owners pay MettleUp for
my_view: My view: do it once Bring a friend is live on the server; add the link to the text share and a small "Join me at <gym>" line on the picture, with a switch to leave it off. Never for a member with no gym.

what: For a member with no gym, end the share text and the picture footer with where to get the app ("Logged with MettleUp, mettleup.fit")
why: The picture says only "Logged with MettleUp" and the text share carries no app name or link, so a friend who likes it cannot find the app; Hevy and Strong share cards carry the app name as a watermark (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: Free installs from every share, at no cost; small but it adds up
my_view: My view: do it, short web address only (no long Play link on the picture). Keep the text share clean for pasting into an AI chat: one last line, nothing more.

what: Ask for a Google Play rating at a good moment: after a workout that beat last time, from about the 5th workout, at most once in a few months
why: The app never asks for a rating anywhere; the Finish screen already knows when a member beat last time or hit a milestone, which is the best moment to ask. Ratings drive store conversion
evidence: data:grep requestReview|StoreReview|rate us over apps/mobile/src = 0 hits
impact_why: More and better stars lift the Play listing for every new member and gym owner who checks it
my_view: My view: do it with Google's own in-app review sheet (Google decides whether to show it; the member never leaves the app). Never after a lighter-day workout or a failed save.

what: Show "about 50 min" on the routine preview and on Up next, from how long this routine took the last few times
why: Members plan around time ("do I have time before work?"); the preview shows only the day type, exercise count and folder. Fitbod lets members pick a workout length and shows it (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: Seen before every workout; helps busy members start instead of skipping
my_view: My view: do it from past workouts of the same routine only; show nothing for a routine never done (no guessing).

what: On Up next, for a gym member, add one line "Gym open till 10 pm" or "Gym closed today" that opens Gym timings
why: Gym timings are two taps away on the Gym tab; the moment a member decides to go is on Up next. The gym already keeps its hours and special days in MettleUp
impact_why: Saves a wasted trip on a holiday or a special closing day
my_view: My view: worth it, but only the line, no new screen; hide it when the hours cannot be read rather than guessing.

what: In Find a plan, add a "From your gym" section listing the plans the gym's trainer sent
why: Find a plan shows Build a plan, ready programs and importing, but not the trainer's plans, which arrive as folders on the Workout tab; a member looking for a plan here misses the one their own gym made
impact_why: Makes the trainer's work visible where members look for plans, which is value the owner pays for
my_view: My view: do it, only when the gym has trainer plans switched on; each row opens the existing folder, no copy.

what: On the monthly report and year in review, add a clear "Share my month" button at the bottom, beside the text share
why: Sharing the picture is only a small paper-plane icon in the top bar, while the text share has a full row at the bottom. The report is the most shareable page; Strava's year in review is built around sharing (as known by Jun 2026, not re-checked live)
impact_why: More shares of the report means more people seeing MettleUp and the gym
my_view: My view: do it; keep the top icon too. Pairs with telling the member the report is ready (already proposed).

what: Offer an optional "photo day" reminder every 4 weeks on the Progress photos page, off until the member turns it on
why: The page already tells members to take a photo "every few weeks" but nothing reminds them; progress photos show change that the weight on the bar does not, and members forget them
impact_why: Keeps members who train for looks coming back and seeing change, which helps day-30 retention
my_view: My view: worth trying, opt-in only, using the same reminder system as workout reminders.

what: Let a member add a screenshot to Help and feedback
why: Help and feedback takes typed or spoken words and the watch log, but not a picture; most app problems are easier to show than describe, and the team answers faster with one
impact_why: Fewer back-and-forth replies on bug reports
my_view: My view: later, not now; worth it once feedback volume grows. It must warn that a screenshot can show personal numbers, and it needs server storage.
